data.one_liner: A JSON viewer widget for Flutter to display data in an extensible list.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that renders JSON data into an interactive, expandable list view. It helps make complex JSON data easily readable on mobile and other devices.
use_when: You need to display raw JSON or debug payloads inside your Flutter app
You want an expandable tree view specifically designed for JSON data structures
avoid_when: You require a fully customizable form builder or JSON editor rather than a read-only viewer
You need complex data manipulation or validation alongside viewing
strengths: Simple to integrate as a single widget
Supports arrays at the root level
